summary: This 8-K reports the closing of a securitization transaction by World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B, an asset-backed securities issuer. On May 13, 2026, the depositor transferred motor vehicle retail installment sale contracts to the issuing entity, which issued $1,316,370,000 in asset-backed notes across multiple classes. The filing documents standard agreements (trust agreement, receivables purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement, indenture, administration agreement) for a routine ABS issuance. No special-situation event is present.
